changes.title: Ukraine’s Top General Becomes a Target of Protesters’ Anger
changes.summary: Demonstrators supporting Ukraine’s ousted defense minister have begun denouncing the commander he clashed with in office, Gen. Oleksandr Syrskyi.

changes.title: Ukrainian drones hit warehouses and other sites across Russia, killing 9 and wounding over 60
changes.summary: Kyiv's forces have pressed their relentless aerial campaign against energy infrastructure and military targets inside Russia, aiming to undermine Moscow's war effort and make Russians feel the consequences of the Kremlin's all-out invasion of Ukraine that is well into its fifth year.

changes.title: Ukraine fights under an interim defense chief after Zelenskyy's contested government shake-up
changes.summary: Ukraine fought Russia's more than 4-year-old invasion under an interim defense minister Friday, a day after a government reshuffle exposed a deep split between the military's old guard and young innovators over how to fight the war.

changes.title: A Russian Political Battle Ends With a Visit From Masked Men
changes.summary: Boris B. Nadezhdin, an outspoken opponent of the war in Ukraine, says he knows why he was detained: “Among our leadership, there is panic and chaos.”.
